fact: Sections 2 to 38, 55 to 109, 111 and 114(1)-(3) of POPIA commenced on 1 July 2020 and sections 110 and 114(4) on 30 June 2021, with compliance required by 1 July 2021; Regulator members took office 1 December 2016.
title: Commencement of certain sections of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013
